title: Hook Event Expansion
brief: Wire all 18 Claude Code hook events for complete lifecycle coverage. Currently only 8 events used (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PreCompact, SessionStart, PermissionRequest, ConfigChange, Stop, TaskCompleted). Add: UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUseFailure, StopFailure, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, WorktreeCreate, WorktreeRemove, PostCompact, SessionEnd, InstructionsLoaded, Elicitation/ElicitationResult.

phases.title: Hook Event Handlers + Integration
phases.description: Create shell-script handlers for all 10 new hook events, integration tests, and advanced auto-recovery behaviors.

units.title: UserPromptSubmit hook
units.rationale: UserPromptSubmit is the entry point for all user interactions. Hooking it enables prompt validation, context injection, and skill routing before any tool calls happen.
entry_conditions: Existing hook scripts available as reference
exit_conditions: Context hints injected for PRISM topics

steps.instruction: Create userpromptsubmit-handler.sh reading JSON from stdin with user_prompt field
Implement prompt validation: reject empty, warn on overly broad requests
Implement context hint injection: detect PRISM topics and prepend digest references
Implement skill pattern matching: scan prompt for /command patterns and known trigger phrases
Register hook in settings.json under UserPromptSubmit event
Test with sample prompts covering skill triggers, PRISM topics, and edge cases

deliverables.description: UserPromptSubmit event handler — validates prompts, injects context, routes skills

units.description: UserPromptSubmit hook — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: PostToolUseFailure hook
units.rationale: Failed tool calls are currently silent. Capturing failures enables pattern analysis, auto-retry for transient errors, and diagnostic logging.
exit_conditions: Error patterns tracked in session state

steps.instruction: Create posttooluse-failure-handler.sh reading JSON with tool_name, error, tool_input fields
Implement error classification: transient (timeout, rate_limit, ENOENT race) vs permanent (syntax, permission, missing dep)
Log failure to ~/.prism/telemetry/tool-failures.jsonl with timestamp, tool, error class
Output JSON with retry recommendation and corrective hints
Register hook in settings.json under PostToolUseFailure event

deliverables.description: PostToolUseFailure handler — classifies errors, logs patterns, recommends retries

units.description: PostToolUseFailure hook — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: StopFailure hook
units.rationale: API failures (rate limits, auth, server errors) need structured handling. StopFailure hook enables automatic backoff, re-auth prompts, and graceful degradation.
exit_conditions: All 7 failure types handled (rate_limit, auth_failed, server_error, network_error, context_overflow, billing, unknown)
Recovery actions specified per failure type

steps.instruction: Create stop-failure-handler.sh reading JSON with error_type, error_message, retry_after fields
Implement 7-way switch: rate_limit→exponential backoff, auth_failed→prompt, server_error→retry, network_error→wait+retry, context_overflow→compact, billing→stop, unknown→log+stop
Calculate backoff with jitter: base * 2^attempt + random(0, base)
Log all failures to ~/.prism/telemetry/api-failures.jsonl
Register hook in settings.json under StopFailure event

deliverables.description: StopFailure handler — handles 7 API failure types with backoff, retry, and recovery

units.description: StopFailure hook — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: SubagentStart hook
units.rationale: Agent spawning is currently untracked. SubagentStart hook enables budget enforcement, context injection, and agent lifecycle logging.
entry_conditions: Claude Code supports SubagentStart hook event
exit_conditions: All agent spawns tracked with model and token budget
Budget cap enforced per agent type

steps.instruction: Create subagent-start-handler.sh reading JSON with agent_name, model, max_turns, task fields
Implement budget enforcement: check cumulative agent token spend against session cap (300K)
Inject PRISM context hints based on agent task description
Log agent spawn to ~/.prism/telemetry/agents.jsonl with timestamp, model, budget
Register hook in settings.json under SubagentStart event

deliverables.description: SubagentStart handler — tracks spawns, enforces budgets, injects context

units.description: SubagentStart hook — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: SubagentStop hook
units.rationale: Agent results need compression and validation. SubagentStop hook captures output quality, compresses verbose results, and enables task chaining.
entry_conditions: SubagentStart hook exists and is registered

steps.instruction: Create subagent-stop-handler.sh reading JSON with agent_name, result, tokens_used, status fields
Compress agent output if >5K chars using summary extraction
Validate completion: check for partial results, silent failures, incomplete deliverables
Update agent ledger in ~/.prism/telemetry/agents.jsonl with final token count and status
Register hook in settings.json under SubagentStop event

deliverables.description: SubagentStop handler — compresses results, validates completion, logs metrics

units.title: WorktreeCreate hook
units.rationale: Worktree creation needs naming validation, branch protection, and CLAUDE.md injection to ensure isolated agents have proper context.
exit_conditions: Worktrees created with proper naming convention (ccm-<purpose>-<date>)

steps.instruction: Create worktree-create-handler.sh reading JSON with worktree_path, branch fields
Validate naming: enforce ccm-<purpose>-YYYYMMDD pattern
Copy CLAUDE.md and .claude/ config into new worktree
Log worktree creation to ~/.prism/telemetry/worktrees.jsonl

units.title: WorktreeRemove hook
units.rationale: Worktree removal needs cleanup validation to prevent data loss — archive results, verify merge status, clean up branches.
exit_conditions: Worktrees cleanly removed with results archived

steps.instruction: Create worktree-remove-handler.sh reading JSON with worktree_path fields
Check for unmerged changes and warn if present
Archive key results (test output, deliverables) to ~/.prism/archives/
Clean up associated branch if fully merged
Log removal to ~/.prism/telemetry/worktrees.jsonl
Register hook in settings.json under WorktreeRemove event

units.title: PostCompact hook
units.rationale: Compaction can lose critical context. PostCompact hook validates that essential facts survive compaction by cross-referencing PreCompact saves.
entry_conditions: Existing precompact-save hook saves critical facts
exit_conditions: Critical facts verified present after compaction
Missing facts restored from PreCompact save file

steps.instruction: Create postcompact-handler.sh reading JSON with compacted_context fields
Load critical facts from PreCompact save (~/.prism/state/precompact-save.json)
Verify each critical fact appears in compacted context
If facts missing, output restoration hints to inject them back
Log compaction quality score to ~/.prism/telemetry/compaction.jsonl
Register hook in settings.json under PostCompact event

deliverables.description: PostCompact handler — validates context survival, restores lost facts, scores quality

units.rationale: Session end is the final opportunity to persist state, save metrics, and update memory before context is lost.
exit_conditions: Session duration and key actions logged

steps.instruction: Create session-end-handler.sh reading JSON with session_id, duration, token_count fields
Aggregate session metrics: total tokens, tool calls, errors, files modified
Write session summary to ~/.prism/telemetry/sessions.jsonl
Clean up temporary state files from ~/.prism/state/
Register hook in settings.json under SessionEnd event

units.title: InstructionsLoaded hook
units.rationale: CLAUDE.md instructions may reference stale paths, deleted files, or outdated rules. InstructionsLoaded hook validates freshness on every load.
exit_conditions: File mtime checked against last known good
Dynamic context injected for current session

steps.instruction: Create instructions-loaded-handler.sh reading JSON with instructions_path, content fields
Extract all file paths referenced in CLAUDE.md content
Check each path exists and compare mtime against threshold (7 days)
Warn on stale or missing references
Register hook in settings.json under InstructionsLoaded event

deliverables.description: InstructionsLoaded handler — validates CLAUDE.md freshness, flags stale references

units.title: UserPromptSubmit auto-skill-match
units.rationale: Extends UserPromptSubmit to automatically detect and invoke matching skills from natural language, not just /command patterns.
exit_conditions: Skill auto-match fires for top 30 skills
Natural language triggers mapped (e.g., 'calculate speed and feed' → /sf)

steps.instruction: Build trigger pattern map: 30 skills × 3-5 trigger phrases each
Implement fuzzy matching with confidence threshold (>0.8)
Add to userpromptsubmit-handler.sh as auto-skill-match module
Test with 50+ sample prompts, verify <5% false positive rate
Add opt-out flag for users who prefer explicit /commands

deliverables.description: Trigger pattern map for 30 skills with natural language phrases

units.title: PostToolUseFailure auto-retry
units.rationale: Transient failures (timeouts, race conditions) can often be resolved by retrying. Auto-retry with exponential backoff + jitter reduces manual intervention.
entry_conditions: PostToolUseFailure hook exists with error classification

steps.instruction: Extend posttooluse-failure-handler.sh with retry logic
Implement exponential backoff: delay = min(base * 2^attempt, 30s) + random(0, base)
Track retry count per tool call in state file
After 3 failed retries, escalate to user with diagnostic info
Test with simulated transient and permanent failures

deliverables.description: Extended PostToolUseFailure handler with auto-retry for transient errors

units.title: StopFailure auto-recovery
units.rationale: Rate limits and server errors are recoverable without user intervention. Auto-recovery reduces session interruptions.

steps.instruction: Extend stop-failure-handler.sh with auto-recovery logic
rate_limit: parse retry-after header, queue with calculated delay
auth_failed: output re-auth instruction to user
server_error: retry up to 3x with increasing delay
Test each recovery path with simulated failures

deliverables.description: Extended StopFailure handler with auto-recovery for all recoverable failure types

units.title: InstructionsLoaded auto-freshness
units.rationale: CLAUDE.md references can go stale as files are renamed, moved, or deleted. Auto-freshness checking prevents hallucinations from outdated instructions.
entry_conditions: InstructionsLoaded hook exists with path extraction
exit_conditions: File mtime vs memory references compared
Missing paths flagged with suggested corrections

steps.instruction: Extend instructions-loaded-handler.sh with auto-freshness logic
Extract all file/path references from CLAUDE.md content
Check each path: exists? mtime within 7 days? content hash matches?
For missing paths, search for likely renames using basename matching
Output warnings with suggested corrections for stale references

deliverables.description: Extended InstructionsLoaded handler with auto-freshness detection and correction suggestions
